svg.title: Krill
svg.desc: Euphausiid krill in side view: carapace over the cephalothorax with the gills exposed below its margin, stalked compound eyes, antennules and antennae, a basket of feathery thoracic legs, six abdominal segments with paired swimming pleopods, a tail fan, the digestive gland seen through the carapace and photophores along the body.
